canonical.title: Self-hosted YouTube archivers: web UI, channel watching, and liked-video sync (2026)

sources.title: MeTube — GitHub
sources.claim: MeTube is a self-hosted web UI for yt-dlp, ~13,806 stars, actively maintained.

sources.title: TubeArchivist — GitHub
sources.claim: TubeArchivist is a self-hosted YouTube media server, ~8,067 stars.

sources.title: PinchFlat — GitHub
sources.claim: PinchFlat is a single-container self-hosted YouTube media manager, ~5,005 stars.

sources.title: ytdl-sub — GitHub
sources.claim: ytdl-sub automates yt-dlp downloads via YAML, ~2,843 stars.

sources.title: TubeSync — GitHub
sources.claim: TubeSync syncs YouTube channels to a local media server, ~2,736 stars.

sources.title: yt-dlp-web-ui — GitHub
sources.claim: yt-dlp-web-ui is a download-only self-hosted web UI, ~2,461 stars.

sources.title: TubeArchivist — docker-compose / RAM requirements
sources.claim: TubeArchivist requires three containers and ~4 GB RAM.

sources.title: TubeArchivist — Channels docs
sources.claim: TubeArchivist Rescan Subscriptions is meant to run once per day.

sources.title: TubeArchivist — Application settings (cookie)
sources.claim: TubeArchivist supports cookie-based Liked Videos sync.

sources.title: PinchFlat — FAQ wiki
sources.claim: PinchFlat supports title regex, cutoff date, min/max duration filters.

sources.title: PinchFlat — YouTube Cookies wiki
sources.claim: PinchFlat warns yt-dlp discourages YouTube cookies due to IP ban risk.

sources.title: 6 Ways to Get YouTube Cookies for yt-dlp in 2026
sources.claim: Chrome 127+ app-bound encryption breaks cookie extraction; Firefox-only in 2026; cookies expire in ~2 weeks.

sources.title: bgutil POT provider — GitHub
sources.claim: bgutil mints proof-of-origin tokens to bypass YouTube bot detection.

sources.title: yt-dlp — GitHub
sources.claim: yt-dlp is the shared core all six tools wrap; ~169k stars.

sources.title: yt-dlp issue #15865 — LOGIN_REQUIRED bot wall
sources.claim: February 2026 LOGIN_REQUIRED bot wall hit all yt-dlp-based tools simultaneously.

sources.title: TubeSync — issue #1310 (stuck downloads)
sources.claim: TubeSync users reported media stuck downloading and HTTP 403 errors from Jan 2025.

sources.title: TubeSync — issue #459 (mass-skipped downloads)
sources.claim: TubeSync has open reports of stalled and mass-skipped downloads.

sources.title: PinchFlat — lifecycle scripts wiki
sources.claim: PinchFlat supports per-event lifecycle scripts (bash/Python, jq bundled).

sources.title: Hacker News — PinchFlat front page
sources.claim: PinchFlat was front-paged on Hacker News as a self-hosted YouTube media manager.

sources.title: XDA — Pinchflat + Jellyfin
sources.claim: PinchFlat's NFO/metadata output drops cleanly into a Jellyfin YouTube library.

sources.title: TubeArchivist — Search docs
sources.claim: TubeArchivist uses Elasticsearch to index titles, descriptions, subtitles and comments.

sources.title: TubeArchivist — Scheduling docs
sources.claim: TubeArchivist's scheduler cannot run more than once per hour.

sources.title: yt-dlp issue #8732 — liked playlist truncation
sources.claim: Known yt-dlp bug can return only ~11 items from a large liked playlist in a single run.

sources.title: TubeSync — using cookies wiki
sources.claim: TubeSync accepts a Netscape cookies file; users confirm pulling Liked Videos with explicit caveat it is at own risk.

sources.title: ytdl-sub — Automating downloads (cron)
sources.claim: ytdl-sub scheduling is external via CRON_SCHEDULE env var.

sources.title: TubeArchivist — FAQ (cookie security)
sources.claim: TubeArchivist warns YouTube invalidates cookies used outside a browser.
